description: A change adds console.log and the repository's no-debug rule applies. Offline (no screen service) the file is not checked, which is a question (fail closed), never a silent pass. fixtures/recorded/rule-no-debug.json has the live answers: the screen says yes with the quoted line and the council fails the rule.

files.text:
